programme.desc: 1974 — Kurayamishitome — Kaei 6. The black ships appear off Uraga, plunging Edo into chaos. Even so, Kitamachi Magistrate’s Office official Nakamura Mondo (Makoto Fujita) remains as inept as ever, but his true identity was once that of a “shikinin” in a covert trade who took money to kill. Meanwhile, Mondo witnesses a man in priest’s robes (Yosuke Kondo) kill a government official with tremendous strength, and then confronts a man in black clothing (Koji Ishizaka) who comes after his money. Later, after reuniting in town with fellow “shikinin” Hanshi (Masaaki Tsusaka) and Okin (Yumiko Nogawa), Mondo decides to take up his covert trade again, and recruits the black-clad man, former retainer Mitsugu Itoi, and the priest-robed man, stonemason Daikichi. The five, as “shiteru-nin,” set out to erase evil from Edo...

Because of a shift in tectonic plates around 100 years ago, Japan lost much of its area to submergence. To preserve Japan's territories, coastal cities sprung up, one after the other. Eventually, they became marine cities, and along with the expansion of sea-lanes to connect them, the need arose for a sizable staff to protect the seas. At the same time, maritime jobs were becoming more popular among women. Hence, the Blue Mermaids, tasked with keeping the seas safe, had become every female student's dream job. This is when childhood friends Akeno Misaki and Moeka China enroll in a marine high school in Yokosuka, along with other girls who share their goal of becoming a Blue Mermaid.

programme.sub-title: The First Step Toward a Comeback
programme.desc: 1995 — Ōsama no Resutoran — Rokuro Harada suddenly became the young owner of the French restaurant "Belle Équipe" after his father's death. At the restaurant, chef Shizuka Isono, bartender Masako Sanjo, and Norichika Mizuhara, the general manager and Rokuro's half-brother, were all working there more or less casually. Then, a man with unwavering passion and a strict professional code, Takeshi Sengoku, appears before them. Inspired by the capable waiter Sengoku, the young staff set out to rebuild the nearly collapsing restaurant, and a cynical, exhilarating human drama full of warmth unfolds.

programme.title: My Sweet Home
programme.desc: 2026 — Mai Suīto Hōmu — The housewife Haruka (Yuriko Ishida), whose children are now independent, lives a rich and peaceful life with her husband. She has friends bound by deep friendship. Their homes and jobs are all different—Tokyo, Hayama, Karuizawa—but now they regularly gather together, sometimes with their partners too. Haruka, Natsuki, Akie. And another friend, Fuyumi, with whom they have grown distant... "Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter" had always been together since their student days. Then, one day, they suddenly receive word of Fuyumi's death. Thinking about Fuyumi, the three reaffirm where they have been, where they are now, and how they want to live from here on as they approach sixty, having lived diligently without ever straying from the rails. "I want to become someone other than myself, even just once." The three remember the wish Fuyumi had voiced while alive. And so they decide to try something silly that might make the Fuyumi in heaven laugh. It was a two-week "trial life" in which they swapped partners.

programme.title: My Sweet Home
programme.desc: 2026 — Mai Suīto Hōmu — The housewife Haruka (Yuriko Ishida), whose children are now independent, lives a rich and peaceful life with her husband. She has friends bound by deep friendship. Their homes and jobs are all different—Tokyo, Hayama, Karuizawa—but now they regularly gather together, sometimes with their partners too. Haruka, Natsuki, Akie. And another friend, Fuyumi, with whom they have grown distant... "Spring, Summer, Autumn, Winter" had always been together since their student days. Then, one day, they suddenly receive word of Fuyumi's death. Thinking about Fuyumi, the three reaffirm where they have been, where they are now, and how they want to live from here on as they approach sixty, having lived diligently without ever straying from the rails. "I want to become someone other than myself, even just once." The three remember the wish Fuyumi had voiced while alive. And so they decide to try something silly that might make the Fuyumi in heaven laugh. It was a two-week "trial life" in which they swapped partners.

programme.title: Bluey: The Car Trip / Ice Cream / The Toilet
programme.desc: ★ 8.6/10 · 2018 — Anime "Burūī" Kuruma no Tabi / Aisukurīmu / O Toire — Full of energy! With curious older sister Bluey and little sister Bingo, everyday life turns into a thrilling grand adventure! The story of a loving Australian Cattle Dog family.

programme.title: Curious George: Snow on Rainbow Hill and More
programme.desc: Anime Osaru no Jōji 「Yuki no Reinbō Hiru」 Hoka — A TV anime series based on the beloved picture books "The Little Monkey" and "Curious George," which have been enjoyed across generations around the world for over 85 years.

programme.title: Anime Oshiri Tantei (138)
programme.desc: "Hmm, smells like something" A brilliant detective who is kind to ladies and loves sweet potatoes - Oshiritsu Detective, along with his assistant Brown, solves any case with a pop!

programme.title: I Love Me: What Kind of Rules Make Everyone Happy?
programme.desc: Ai Rabu Mī Minna ga Tanoshii Rule tte Donna Rule? — An adventure animation in which a 5-year-old child learns to cherish "the self" - Voice cast: Hikari Mitsushima - Music: Humbert Humbert - Script: Takeshi Takemura - Character design: obak

programme.title: Mini Anime: Nuezumi-kun's Jacket
programme.desc: Mini Anime Nezumikun no Chokki — Mouse-kun is invited to Penguin’s concert. He is put in charge of the trumpet, but he can’t get a good sound out of it. Mouse-kun looks for an instrument that suits him best...

programme.title: Go! Go! Kitchen Squadron Cookluns
programme.sub-title: The night the fused human cries
programme.desc: 2013 — Gō! Gō! Kitchin Sentai Kukurun — A food-education entertainment programme that links animation and live action. Yomogi, Cryn, and Mameko find their father's body taken over by a magician, and then have to fight against alien monsters carrying out a plan to invade Earth.

programme.title: Gyogyotto Sakana Star: Porcupinefish
programme.desc: Gyogyotto Sakana★Sutā Harisenbon — The pufferfish, which inflates like a balloon and becomes covered in spikes, has defensive power among the strongest in the fish world. It hides surprising secrets of its body. There is also moving footage of fish helping each other with their poor swimming skills!

programme.title: The Villains’ Side: Koala vs. Kangaroo
programme.desc: Viran no Iibun Kōara vs. Kangarū — Why are Australia's two biggest idols clashing!? Are kangaroos actually violent muscleheads!? Are koala babies filthy little things that even eat poop!? So, which one is the villain!?

programme.title: Science Zero
programme.sub-title: Protect Daily Life from a Magnitude 7 Quake! Latest Report on the Kumamoto Earthquake
programme.desc: 2003 — Saiensu Zero — The Kumamoto Earthquake occurred this July. Distinctive shaking that caused damage to buildings and other structures has come into view. How can we build a society resilient to earthquakes? We report on the current state of countermeasures and the new issues that have emerged.

programme.title: Cat and the Museum of Art 33: A Painting That Drew “Air
programme.desc: Nekonomé Bijutsukan 33-hōme "Kūki" o Egaita E — The two Catchu Eyes took the mountain train to the Pola Museum of Art. According to the apprentice cat, the target is a 'painting that depicts the air,' but what does that mean? Also, Kotone Furukawa's 'Painter's Song'

programme.title: Weekly Sign Language News
programme.desc: Shūkkan Shuwa Nyūsu — We bring you sign-language and video reports on events that happened in Japan and overseas over the past week. *The content to be broadcast will be posted as soon as it is decided.

programme.title: E Tele Time Machine
programme.desc: 2022 — E Tere Taimu Mashīn — Encore broadcasts of nostalgic children's programs that have colored the history of E Tele (educational television). This time, it's "Quintet" from 2011.

programme.title: Sukusuku Kosodate: Taking on a Slightly Dangerous Challenge!
programme.desc: Sukusuku Kosodate Chotto Abunai Koto ni Charenji! — Kitchen knives, climbing trees, high places... Should we watch over the "slightly dangerous things" children get absorbed in? When should we stop them? A careful introduction to ways of respecting a child's desire to take on challenges!

programme.title: Stylish Handmade: Popular Crochet! A Soft Snood with a Candy Pattern
programme.desc: Suteki ni Handomeido Ninki no Kagibariami! Kyandī Monyō no Yawaraka Sunūdo — Needlework creator Marchel suggests a crocheted snood that looks like an elaborate design even with basic stitches. Its fluffy, candy-like mysterious pattern is adorable.

programme.title: Koyuki and the Fermentation Grandma: Aomori Tsugaru's Colorful Rice Pickles, Sushiko
programme.desc: Koyuki to Hakkō Obāchan Aomori, Tsugaru Irodzuyaka! Gohan no Tsukemono Sushiko — Pickles with rice!? "Sushiko," handed down in Aomori Prefecture, is a vivid pink traditional food made by fermenting glutinous rice and vegetables. The program's first "fermentation sisters" also appear! Koyuki visits her proud garden.

programme.title: 365 Days of Menu Diary Special
programme.sub-title: Sadako Sawamura and my Derenko Derenko.
programme.desc: Sanbyakurokujūgo-nichi no Kondate Nikki Supesharu — A comforting visual presentation of menus that solve the worries of everyday cooking. Based on the menu diary kept for 26 and a half years by the great Showa-era actress Sadako Sawamura, food stylist Nami Iijima cooks.

programme.title: Otona Jikan Kenkyūjo: The Deep World of Coffee
programme.desc: Otona Jikan Kenkyūjo Okudakai Kōhī no Sekai — This is an encore broadcast. We invite guests who love coffee and introduce delicious brewing methods and beans that are currently in the spotlight. A barista aged 96 also appears!

programme.title: The Backyard: Exploring the Backstage of a Maze of Knowledge — NHK Symphony Orchestra Special
programme.desc: Za Bakkyādo Chi no Meikyū no Uragawa Tanbō NHK Kōkyō Gakudan Supesharu — One of Japan's leading orchestras. Jo Kaname conducts an in-depth report behind the scenes as they work to create their best performance for the 100th anniversary special concert. We also follow the people supporting the orchestra from behind the scenes. Their unknown side is revealed for the first time!

programme.title: Laughing Red List, Episode 7
programme.desc: Warau Reddo Risuto Dai 7-kai — Zetsuken. A facility bringing together the best of science to prevent the extinction of rare animals. Animals of all kinds complain to us again today. In the seventh episode, we feature the dugong, said to have inspired the model for the Little Mermaid.

programme.title: Amazing Earth: Animals That Don’t Mind the Cold
programme.desc: Chikyū Doramachikku Samusa mo Hechara Dōbutsu Zukan — How did animals survive the harsh winter? This programme showcases the astonishing adaptability of animals living in frigid regions, as well as their ingenuity and resilience in the face of severe nature.

programme.title: Inai Inai Baa!: It's an Autumn of Art, Wan
programme.desc: Inai Inai Baa! Geijutsu no Aki da Wan — A programme for children aged 0 to 2. By stimulating the senses with images and sound, it draws out children’s various possibilities and abilities. It also encourages rich parent-child interaction.

programme.title: Okaasan to Issho: Saturday, Takamatsu 1
programme.desc: Okaasan to Issho Doyōbi Takamatsu 1 — An educational entertainment program for children from around age 2. Full of fun segments such as songs, gymnastics, puppetry and animation! It supports toddlers' emotional development, expression, language and physical growth.

programme.title: Aokiiro Minna no for every child: Ibaraki Version
programme.desc: Aokiiro Minna no for every child Ibaraki Bājon — NHK × Sesame Street × UNICEF collaboration project! This time, we'll ask people in Ibaraki Prefecture about "what every child needs."

programme.title: Thomas & Friends: "Return the Cowbell" and More
programme.desc: Anime Kikansha Tōmasu « Kauberu o Kaeshite » hoka — The newly revamped animation series Thomas the Tank Engine returns to ETV - "Bring Back the Cowbell" "Topham Hatt's Hat"

programme.title: The Bread Thief
programme.desc: Anime Pan Dorobō — A shadow leaps out from the neighborhood bakery. It's the great thief who loves bread, Pan Dorobou!! In search of the world's most delicious bread, he sneaks into bakeries again today!

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants: "Did Mrs. Puff Turn into a Potato?!" and More
programme.desc: Anime Suponji Bobu « Paffu-sensei ga Jagaimo ni?! » hoka — A high-energy anime depicting the humorous and fun everyday life of SpongeBob and his friends, who live in Bikini Town, a city at the bottom of the deep sea!

programme.title: Mini Anime: Norimono Man: Mobile Land no Car-kun — "Yellow Workers Are in Disarray!
programme.desc: Mini Anime Norimono Man Mōbiru Rando no Kākun ▽ Barabara! Ierō Wākāzu — Dunk and Laura are fighting!? Karkan tries to make them make up, but it doesn't seem to be working. At this rate, the Yellow Workers will fall apart and the construction work won't get done!

programme.title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
programme.desc: 2026 — Anime Marronie Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi — In the Maronie Kingdom at the center of the eight nations lived seven knight brothers, each with a distinct personality. Their noble cause: "Someday, to save a princess in a cool way!!" A tale of love and adventure begins!!

programme.title: The Legend of Shen Li (New)
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — Yo Hō Kō — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

programme.title: The Legend of Shen Li
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — Yo Hō Kō — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

programme.title: Mito Komon, Part 1 (New)
programme.desc: 1969 — Mito Kōmon Dai 1-bu — Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Eijiro Tono) was living in retirement at Nishiyamaso in Hitachi Province, working the fields while compiling the Dai Nihonshi and teaching nearby children to read and write. Mito retainers Sasaki Sukesaburo (Sugitaro Sugi) and Atsumi Kakunoshin (Masashi Yokouchi) were ordered by the domain to assist Mitsukuni, but they were starting to feel restless from the overly peaceful days. One day, the father of Kakunoshin’s betrothed, Miyuki, committed seppuku in front of the gate of the Mito clan elder’s residence. Something serious seems to be hidden behind the incident. At the same time, Mitsukuni received a document from the righteous thief Kazaguruma no Yajiro (Ichiro Nakatani). It was a secret letter addressed to Mito’s Edo elder, Fujii Montayu, from senior councilor Yanagisawa Yoshiyasu, Mitsukuni’s adversary. It appears that Yoshiyasu and Montayu are conspiring with each other to seize control of both the shogunate and the Mito domain. And so Mitsukuni, Sukesaburo, and Kakunoshin set off from Mito under the pretense of being a retired owner of a Chichibu crepe dealer and his servant...

Enlisting the help of a rookie private eye and a reluctant old flame, Stillwell uncovers the mystery detail by unexpected detail.

programme.title: Mito Komon, Part 1
programme.desc: 1969 — Mito Kōmon Dai 1-bu — Tokugawa Mitsukuni (Eijiro Tono) was living in retirement at Nishiyamaso in Hitachi Province, working the fields while compiling the Dai Nihonshi and teaching nearby children to read and write. Mito retainers Sasaki Sukesaburo (Sugitaro Sugi) and Atsumi Kakunoshin (Masashi Yokouchi) were ordered by the domain to assist Mitsukuni, but they were starting to feel restless from the overly peaceful days. One day, the father of Kakunoshin’s betrothed, Miyuki, committed seppuku in front of the gate of the Mito clan elder’s residence. Something serious seems to be hidden behind the incident. At the same time, Mitsukuni received a document from the righteous thief Kazaguruma no Yajiro (Ichiro Nakatani). It was a secret letter addressed to Mito’s Edo elder, Fujii Montayu, from senior councilor Yanagisawa Yoshiyasu, Mitsukuni’s adversary. It appears that Yoshiyasu and Montayu are conspiring with each other to seize control of both the shogunate and the Mito domain. And so Mitsukuni, Sukesaburo, and Kakunoshin set off from Mito under the pretense of being a retired owner of a Chichibu crepe dealer and his servant...

programme.title: The Legend of Shen Li
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2024 — Yo Hō Kō — The ancient gods died, and there is only one last god in the world - Xingzhi. Rumor has it that this God of Action has lived alone in the heavens for tens of thousands of years, ruthless and lustless. In the battle of the immortals and demons, he turned the tide by himself, and since then, Du Men has been swept away, and his traces are hard to find. Hundreds of years are just a click away. As the queen who was born with a pearl in the devil world, Shen Li's life was bright and dazzling. But on the occasion of her thousand-year-old birthday, the claws of political marriage were scratching their heads. On the way to escape from the marriage, Shen Li was beaten back to the original form of a phoenix and fell to the world with injuries. When she was seriously injured and comatose, the mortal hawker treated her as a fat chicken, plucked all the hair from her body, and locked her in a cage for sale. The fate of the two is tightly linked by a seemingly casual transaction.

programme.title: Quiz Derby
programme.desc: Kuizu Dābī — A quiz show that emphasizes entertainment in a horse-race format, in which contestants are likened to racing horses and bet their own points, using reasoning and intuition, on the contestant most likely to get the answer right. The questions vary widely each time, from general knowledge to jokes packed with gags. Three teams of two contestants each place bets in units of at least 100 points out of their 3,000 points, referring to the arbitrarily assigned odds the host gives to the five contestants. The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

programme.desc: Kuizu Dābī — A quiz show that emphasizes entertainment in a horse-race format, in which contestants are likened to racing horses and bet their own points, using reasoning and intuition, on the contestant most likely to get the answer right. The questions vary widely each time, from general knowledge to jokes packed with gags. Three teams of two contestants each place bets in units of at least 100 points out of their 3,000 points, referring to the arbitrarily assigned odds the host gives to the five contestants. The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

programme.title: Tokuda Detective Series
programme.desc: 1993 — Tokuda Keiji Shirīzu — Detective Nakao (Matsumura Yuki) lost his sister to a rape-murder five years ago and has lived only to find the culprit and kill him with his own hands. Together with his senior, Detective Tokuda (Tamura Takahiro), he arrests the culprit one minute before the statute of limitations expires... A serious drama based on a work by Hisayuki Nishimura, which deftly portrays the trick behind the statute of limitations. The obsession of the detective whose sister was killed, and the psychology of the veteran detective trying to solve the case calmly, intertwine brilliantly, while violence and deduction drive the drama forward with force. Young detective Nakao, assigned to the First Investigation Division, had his sister murdered 15 years earlier. To veteran detective Tokuda, who knew Nakao back then saying, "I'll kill the culprit with my own hands," their meeting can be seen as fateful. But there is only one week left before that case, too, reaches its statute of limitations. Nakao, who has lived only to kill his sister's murderer, has been whispered about as a "violent detective" who bares his hatred toward criminals. Then a report comes in that the fingerprints of a man named Harada, who caused a traffic accident, match those of the culprit from 15 years ago, and Nakao takes leave and heads to Kyushu.

programme.title: TOKYO MER: Mobile Emergency Room (New)
programme.desc: 2021 — TOKYO MER ~Hashiru Kinkyū Kyūmeishitsu~ — TOKYO MER is formed by order from the Governor of Tokyo. The name of the group stands for TOKYO Mobile Emergency Room. The members are emergency care professionals and they are to go to sites of dangerous accidents and disasters by ER car. Their ER car is a large vehicle equipped with the latest medical devices and an operating area. There, TOKYO MER saves lives of the injured. Kōta Kitami is a doctor for TOKYO MER and its leader. He holds a strong conviction that, regardless of the dangers, he will go to accident sites to save lives.

programme.title: TOKYO MER: Sumidagawa Mission
programme.desc: 2023 — TOKYO MER ~Sumidagawa Misshon~ — Half a year has passed since the official approval of TOKYO MER. Kitami is racking his brains over the issue of a second doctor to replace Otowa, who has left the team in order to expand MER to ordinance-designated cities nationwide. Some members of the team want Hina to be promoted, but Otowa asserts that Hina should pursue her path of cardiovascular surgery. She felt the pressure that Hina could take Otowa's place, and she was troubled.

programme.title: Quiz Derby
programme.desc: Kuizu Dābī — A quiz show that emphasizes entertainment in a horse-race format, in which contestants are likened to racing horses and bet their own points, using reasoning and intuition, on the contestant most likely to get the answer right. The questions vary widely each time, from general knowledge to jokes packed with gags. Three teams of two contestants each place bets in units of at least 100 points out of their 3,000 points, referring to the arbitrarily assigned odds the host gives to the five contestants. The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

The outcome depends on whether to steadily bet on Hara Taira or the "queen of three choices" Keiko Takeshita, whose odds are low but whose accuracy is high, or to go for a huge payoff by betting on answerers like Dai Kitano or Miyuki Imori, whose odds are high but whose accuracy is not so great. The winner is not known until the very end, and contestants receive prize money equal to their score.

programme.title: Dangerous Venus (New)
programme.desc: 2020 — Kiken na Bīnasu — Hakuro is single and works as a veterinarian. His father died when Hakuro was a child and his mother later remarried into the wealthy Yagami family. Although Hakuro was brought into the Yagami family through his mother's marriage, he does not feel like part of the Yagami family. Especially, when compared to his younger step-brother who possesses the same blood as his family. After the death of Hakuro's mother, Hakuro dropped Yagami from his name and broke off relations with that family. Hakuro has a strong sense of justice and sincerity in his actions. He is very susceptible to beautiful women. One day, he meets a woman. The woman introduces herself as the wife of his stepbrother and informs him that his stepbrother is missing. As Hakuro and the woman trace his stepbrother's whereabouts, Hakuro becomes involved in the Yagami family's fight over a three billion yen inheritance.

Needless to say, this move was not well-favored by the existing management who themselves were vying for the job. However, his proposal is opposed by all the other top management, especially Sasai Kotaro, a long-serving employee who feels that he should have been promoted to President instead of Mitsuru. Mikami Fumio, who is the baseball club's manager, also tries to foil Mitsuru's plans of selling the club. Amidst all the enmity of the long-serving management, and also sabotage from a rival company, Mitsuru has to find a way to save the company from its downfall...

programme.title: Tokyo Revengers
programme.desc: ★ 8.4/10 · 2021 — Tōkyō Ribenjāzu — Takemichi Hanagaki is a freelancer that’s reached the absolute pits of despair in his life. He finds out that the only girlfriend he ever had, in middle school, Hinata Tachibana, had been killed by the ruthless Tokyo Manji Gang. The day after hearing about her death, he’s standing on the station platform and ends up being pushed over onto the tracks by a herd of people. He closes his eyes thinking he’s about to die, but when he opens his eyes back up, he somehow had gone back in time 12 years. Now that he’s back living the best days of his life, Takemichi decides to get revenge on his life.

This catches the eye of Jinshi, a handsome palace official who promotes her. Now, she's making a name for herself solving medical mysteries!

Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

programme.title: The Wings of Rean

She said her name was Lyx, the princess of another world, and added, "My Father is Japanese, Shinjiro Sakomizu. Please help me, Suzuki." programme.title: Aibou
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Aibō — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: Gu.Ra.Me! ~The Prime Minister's Chef~
programme.desc: 2016 — Gu・Ra・Me! ~Sōri no Ryōriban~ — The heroine is the Prime Minister’s Chef, a post revived after 70 years since the Yoshida Cabinet. A 25 year old female chef, Kurumi Ichiki is appointed to the post skipping over veteran chefs for her extraordinary talent. And the female genius chef sails into the Prime Minister’s residence, which is still very much male dominant, and takes it over and captivates VIPs and politicians with her exquisite culinary skills. An exciting and entertaining culinary drama filled with wide variety of mouthwatering dishes from authentic highbrow French cuisine to down-to-earth creative cross-culture dishes popular among today’s young gourmets.

programme.title: Hot Stove League
programme.desc: 2026 — Sutōbu Rīgu — The professional baseball team “Dreams” has long been stuck in last place. Factional disputes within the team, players repeatedly making defensive errors—the organization is on the verge of collapse. Entrusted with rebuilding the Dreams is Sakurazaki Jun, a general manager with no experience playing baseball. Although he lacks competitive experience, he is known as a “championship contractor” who has led multiple sports teams to victory. In order to address the root of the problems, Sakurazaki clashes with players and front office staff while introducing a series of unconventional reforms that defy common sense. And the first decision he makes is trading the star player, who is considered the symbol of the franchise. What is victory? What is a team? Not only the players, but also the club staff are drawn into confronting these questions.

programme.title: Sumika Sumire: 45 Years Old, Rejuvenated Woman (New)
programme.desc: 2016 — Sumika Sumire 45-sai Wakagaetta Onna — Kisaragi Sumi is a 20-year-old university student. But do not be surprised that she is a 65-year-old inside. Under pressure to help out with the family business from a young age, she could not have a youth. Even afterwards, she devoted her entire life to taking care of first her grandmother and then her father and mother. Sumi finds herself turning 65 without ever having had a boyfriend. She takes a little pride in having lived with integrity. But after her mother passes away, she has the sudden thought of regaining her youth once more and making a fresh start in life. A miracle happens to her. One day when Sumi wakes up, she has the appearance of a 20-year-old. Despite being bewildered by this unbelievable reality, she introduces herself as Sumire and gets another try at youth.

programme.title: Aibou
programme.desc: ★ 7.5/10 · 2002 — Aibō — Detective Ukyo Sugishita confronts crime on the basis of his own convictions. He has a partner that works for him in the Special Task Unit. For the first 7 seasons, Ukyo’s first partner is Kaoru Kameyama. He is a good-natured, hot-tempered, straightforward and somewhat scattered detective. Beginning in Season 8, Takeru Kanbe replaces Kameyama. Contrary to his predecessor, Takeru is a lanky, cool, conceited and confident detective. From Season 11 to Season 13, Ukyo’s partner is a young detective Toru Kai. Toru is a son of Deputy Director-General of The National Police Agency. But he became a detective by his own effort. And starting with Season 14, Ukyo’s current partner is Wataru Kaburagi, an elite bureaucrat who came to the Metropolitan Police Department on temporary assignment. As the first partner without any career of a police officer, he will face challenging cases together with Ukyo.

programme.title: Perman
programme.desc: 1983 — Pāman — Mitsuo encountered Superman, an alien who is a part of a federation that tries to maintain peace in the galaxy. He then received a helmet (that also serves as a mask) that gives superhuman strength, a cape that enables the wearer to fly, and a badge that allows him to breathe underwater and communicate with his fellow comrades whom he met soon after he utilized these gifts. Superman made it clear to all Permans that their identity must be kept a secret or their brain will be destroyed should it ever be revealed and they are given a special doppelganger robot that can replace them while they are away to achieve this feat, although it is not entirely foolproof nor is it free from potential problems. These equipments then allowed them to be young Permans who try to maintain peace and help the people who are in need.

programme.title: Doctor-X: Surgeon Michiko Daimon (2012) (New)
programme.desc: ★ 7.7/10 · 2012 — Dokutā X ~ Gekai Daimon Michiko ~ (2012) — Daimon Michiko is a 37-year-old freelance surgeon who is part of a questionable “doctor placement service” that has her wander from hospital to hospital. The harsh environment at the hospitals led many doctors to retire from their positions, forcing hospitals to make use of said program to fill the empty spots at least temporary. However, Michiko doesn’t look like a doctor at all with her flashy clothes and eccentric attitude. In the first episode she raises objections to a certain operation which is planned to be done by the head of a hospital who hasn’t performed an operation for a very long time. This causes Michiko to incur odium at the hospital, however, everyone becomes frozen when Michiko points out the outdated skills of the director. She also holds a scrupulous compliance when it comes to her working hours, never does any unnecessary chores that don’t require a medical license, and couldn’t care less about the power struggles within the hospitals. Nobody knows how she acquired such a top-level skill that allows her to claim exorbitant sums as reward, but her private life is an even greater mystery to everyone around her. Tanaka plays a rookie surgeon, Uchida an anesthetist, Kishibe the head of the placement service, and Ito the head of the surgical department of this institution.

programme.title: Taxi Driver's Investigation Diary
programme.desc: 1992 — Takushī Doraibā no Suiri Nissi — "Taxi Driver's Investigation Diary" is a television drama series broadcast on TV Asahi's Saturday Wide Theatre slot from May 1992 to March 2016. It ran for 39 installments. Starring Tsunehiko Watase. A mystery drama in which a taxi driver with a past as a highly capable former Metropolitan Police detective solves cases involving his passengers from his own unique perspective. Because lead actor Watase died on March 14, 2017, the 39th film, broadcast in 2016, was the final one [notes 1][notes 2][notes 3]. At the beginning of the 32nd installment, "Passenger in a Murder Tour: Shinshu Matsumoto - A Schemed Little Kyoto Trip!!," broadcast on March 19, 2017 as a memorial program, a video looking back on Watase's career and achievements was shown as a tribute, narrated by announcer Yoko Oshita.

Whoever claims the "One Piece" will be named the new King of the Pirates. Monkey D. It helps, of course, that his body has the properties of rubber and that he's surrounded by a bevy of skilled fighters and thieves to help him along the way. Luffy will do anything to get the One Piece and become King of the Pirates!

programme.title: Korean Drama: Wind and Cloud and Rain
programme.desc: 2020 — Kankoku Dorama « Kaze to Kumo to Ame » — In the late 19th century, the Joseon Dynasty is in peril because the Kim Family abuses power. The king's power has already weakened, and the people are suffering famine and hardship. Choi Chon-joong is Joseon's best fortune teller and physiognomist, who lost people he loves to Kim Family. He swore to overthrow the Kims and reform the country. He read the hunger to power in Lee Ha-eung, a humble-looking member of the royal family, and decides to help him to set his son on the throne. Meanwhile, the Kims also find the heir to the throne, using Bong-ryun's special gift. Bong-ryun, the daughter of the current king, has the power of psychometry. While the royals and powerful politicians are making and breaking alliances to get ahold of the thrones, Chon-joong focuses on kingmaking that can bring Chosun a new era.

programme.title: Unmet: A Neurosurgeon's Diary
programme.desc: 2024 — Anmetto - Aru Nōgeka Ishi no Nikki - — Kawauchi Miyabi was once a promising neurosurgeon, but an accident caused damage to Miyabi's brain. She is unable to remember the past 2 years of her life and she will forget everything that happened today when she wakes up the next day. She has all but given up on becoming a doctor and works as an assistant nurse. One day, Neurosurgeon Sanpei Tomoharu appears in front of her. He is known as an eccentric person. Sanpei Tomoharu guides Kawauchi Miyabi at his own pace, regardless of her will. This actually helps Kawauchi Miyabi as a doctor and a patient. The mystery hidden in her missing memories is gradually revealed, which contains a secret.

programme.title: Japan Boro Inn Travelogue
programme.desc: 2019 — Nihon Boro Yado Kiko — "Boro-yado" is not an insult. It has melancholy, nostalgia, atmosphere, and a sense of sabi and wabi. A sales trip begins as a struggling singer and a company president tour lovable real-life "boro-yado" inns across the country! Haruko Shinomiya (Mai Fukagawa), 27, inherits the entertainment agency Spring Roll after her father, Ippei, suddenly dies. However, almost all of the talent signed to it has quit, leaving only Ryuji Sakuraba (Kazuya Takahashi), a 48-year-old one-hit-wonder pop singer... To sell off a large stock of CDs from a past smash hit, the two set out on a local sales tour with just one suitcase. As they travel from one region to another, visiting the various real-life "boro-yado" inns they encounter along the way, can Haruko turn Ryuji, who has no motivation but plenty of pride, back into a popular singer? A mismatched duo's rags-to-riches comeback story begins now!! See more

The moment you watch this program, you're sure to fall in love with Hawaii! This episode spotlights happy hour at International Market Place in the heart of Waikiki, where you can enjoy shopping and gourmet dining. Happy hour is hugely popular not only with tourists but also with locals, since it lets you enjoy snacks and drinks at lower prices for a limited time. Lately, more and more restaurants have been creating their own happy hours, and some let you enjoy happy hour all day long! From a seafood happy hour, rare even in Hawaii, to hearty fusion dishes, Mexican street food, and even superb steaks crafted by a Michelin-starred chef. programme.title: Drinking Around Kyoto with the Old Guys
programme.desc: 2022 — Oyaji Kyōto Nomi — Katsunori Tanaka, a big fan of Kyoto, and Yoshiaki Kondo, who moved to Kyoto, two unique actors go bar-hopping through Kyoto in search of great drinks and snacks! Katsunori Taniguchi, a true Kyoto expert, spends more than 60 days a year in Kyoto. Meanwhile, Yoshiaki Kondo has been living in Kyoto since 2020, after getting married. What happens when these two distinctive actors, both captivated by Kyoto, set out on a drinking journey? ---A new-style gourmet entertainment show set in Kyoto, featuring middle-aged men! From popular restaurants that are hard to book to hidden gems known only to insiders, and casual izakaya stops along the way---we introduce a wide variety of places, regardless of cuisine, while teaching the proper way to enjoy Kyoto drinking. This time, it's the middle-aged men's summer holiday! After the two take a boat ride in Arashiyama, of course, they are not drunk yet! Their bar-hopping starts in the Arashiyama-Sagano area. First, they visit a steakhouse that was frequented by writer Jakucho Setouchi, also known for her refined taste. The owner is the son of a film director who supported the golden age of Japanese cinema, so many movie stars used to come here, and the two actors get excited talking about nostalgic names. They relax with wine, savoring carefully selected vegetables and meat. Then, at Seiryo-ji Temple, associated with Hikaru Genji, they cool off with shaved ice. The sight of the two middle-aged men sharing one bowl of shaved ice is adorable! After enjoying the bamboo grove and travel atmosphere at Adashino Nenbutsu-ji Temple, they visit a long-established ayu restaurant founded in the Edo period. The natural ayu sashimi is delightfully springy. With carefully charcoal-grilled salt-roasted ayu, and finishing with gentle-flavored ayu porridge, they indulge in a full ayu feast, drinking more and more sake---a perfect taste of Kyoto's adult summer. Don't miss it! See more

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō
programme.desc: 2021 — Watashitachi Tetsuinchō Hajimemasu — Set off on a carefree journey to collect "Tetsuin" stamps on local railway lines across Japan! Like collecting "goshuin" seals, these "tetsuin" stamps can be collected on 40 local railway companies nationwide. This project began through cooperation between railway companies and affiliated firms belonging to the Council for the Promotion of Third Sector Railway Lines, with the aim of revitalizing communities along local railways. In this program, we bring you the carefree stamp-collecting travels of two actresses, with beautiful single-lens camera footage and carefully selected music. Do you know about a "Tetsuin Book"? In a sense, it is the railway version of collecting goshuin seals. This program is a rail travel show where you collect the tetsuin from 40 routes nationwide. In the first episode, Maryjun Takahashi, who loves travel and nature, invites her junior colleague Mayuna Saburi on a trip to Echigo Tokimeki Railway in Niigata Prefecture in search of tetsuin. Leaving Myoko Kogen Station, the landscape quickly opens onto the rice fields typical of Niigata - when the route reaches the coast, the view from the train window becomes the endless horizon of the Sea of Japan - the stations where you can get Toki Tetsuin are Naoetsu Station and Itoigawa Station. Seeking two different designs of tetsuin, they head off on a local line journey to enjoy both sea and mountain scenery. More

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō
programme.desc: 2021 — Watashitachi Tetsuinchō Hajimemasu — A carefree trip across local rail lines all over Japan to collect "tetsuin"! Like collecting "goshuin", "tetsuin" can be collected on 40 local rail lines nationwide. This began through cooperation between railway companies and related companies belonging to the Council of Third Sector Railway Operators, with the aim of revitalizing local communities along regional railway lines. In this program..., two actresses set out on a carefree tetsuin-collecting journey, with beautiful images shot on a single-lens camera and carefully selected music. This time, they depart from Itoigawa Station in Niigata Prefecture. They travel on Ainokaze Toyama Railway in search of the "tetsuin" available at Takaoka Station in Toyama Prefecture. While riding local lines, Maryjun Takahashi and her agency junior Mayuna Saburi encounter the beautiful scenery of the Tateyama Mountain Range seen from the train window and the endlessly stretching horizon of the Sea of Japan. Along the way, they make stops and enjoy the seafood of Toyama Bay. In search of their fifth tetsuin, they set out on a journey on the Ainokaze Toyama Railway. More

programme.title: Drinking Around Kyoto with the Old Guys
programme.desc: 2022 — Oyaji Kyōto Nomi — Kutao Takuzo, who loves Kyoto, and Yoshimasa Kondo, who moved to Kyoto—two distinctive actors go drinking their way through Kyoto in search of good sake and appetizers! Takuzo Kutao, a Kyoto expert who stays in Kyoto more than 60 days a year, and Yoshimasa Kondo, who began living in Kyoto in 2020 after getting married. What happens when these two charismatic actors, both fascinated by Kyoto, go out drinking? A new-style gourmet entertainment show set in Kyoto! From hard-to-book popular spots to hidden gems known only to insiders, and casual taverns to drop into along the way—we introduce a wide variety of eateries regardless of cuisine and teach you the proper style of Kyoto drinking. This program began with Kondo Yoshimasa learning the manners of “oyaji drinking” from Takuzo Kutao. This time, the theme is “Oyaji drinking on the Sea of Tango”! For the first time on the show, they travel to northern Kyoto Prefecture in search of tasty sake and snacks. They watch the harvesting of farmed rock oysters in Maizuru, then enjoy them at an oyster hut. After that, they savor seafood and wine at an Italian restaurant in Miyazu. In Ine Town, they tour a sake brewery and toast with local sake while looking out at the sea, enjoying even the brewer’s handmade side dishes. After spending a relaxing time by the calm seaside, they head to a local diner. Their hearts and stomachs are filled with fresh fish, and they fully savor the rich seafood of northern Kyoto Prefecture and meet the people who protect it. Please enjoy this trip by the grown men! programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō
programme.desc: 2021 — Watashitachi Tetsuinchō Hajimemasu — Set off on a free and easy trip to collect "train stamps" on local railway lines across Japan! Like collecting goshuin, "train stamps" can be collected on 40 local railway companies nationwide. This began through cooperation between member railway companies and related firms of the Third-Sector Railway Council, with the aim of promoting local areas along regional railway lines. In this program..., two actresses take a carefree trip to collect train stamps, accompanied by beautiful images shot with a single-lens camera and carefully selected music. The railway version of a goshuincho is the "train stamp book." Sisters Maryjun Takahashi and Yuu return to their hometown in Shiga in search of train stamps. Starting from Lake Biwa, the largest lake in Japan, they take Keihan Electric Railway from the nostalgic Ishiba Station to Kibukawa Station. They transfer to the Shigaraki Kogen Railway they came for, aiming for Shigaraki Station, famous for tanuki pottery. On a stopover, they take a stroll to see the mythical capital, Shigaraki-no-miya, as told to them by local people. A delicious lunch using fresh Omi rice cooked in a pot. At the suspension bridge by Tsumekakeji-mae Station, they find an excellent railway photo spot. Along the way, they meet a train-stamp meister, making for a rich journey. As a result, the Shigaraki Railway train stamp will have to wait until next time. The sisters' local train journey continues. More

programme.title: We’re Starting Our Tetsuinchō
programme.desc: 2021 — Watashitachi Tetsuinchō Hajimemasu — Set off on a freewheeling journey to collect "Tetsuin" stamps on local railway lines across Japan! Like collecting goshuin, "Tetsuin" can be collected on local railway lines run by 40 companies nationwide. It began through cooperation between railway companies and related firms that joined the Third Sector Railway Association, with the aim of revitalizing communities along regional railway lines. In this program... two actresses take you on a carefree Tetsuin-collecting journey, with beautiful camera imagery and carefully selected music. "Tetsuincho," the railway version of a goshuincho. The Takahashi Maryjun-Yuu sisters head back to their hometown in Shiga in search of Tetsuin, part two. At Tamakyuji Temple beyond the suspension bridge from the previous episode, they see a huge Dainichi Fudō Myōō. At their destination, Shigaraki Station, they are greeted by lots of tanuki ceramic figures. They receive two kinds of Tetsuin. In the Shigaraki town overflowing with tanuki pottery everywhere, they relax at a scarlet climbing-kiln café. And they finish with the long-awaited Omi beef shabu-shabu in this thoroughly enjoyable local line trip through Shiga. More

programme.title: Anpanman
programme.sub-title: Katsubushiman and the Cat Kingdom" and more
programme.desc: Soreike! Anpanman — Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.desc: Soreike! Anpanman — Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.sub-title: Shingumaki and the Donburi Man Trio," and more
programme.desc: Soreike! Anpanman — Anpanman is a superhero who dedicates himself to the cause of justice, aiding the plight of unfortunate souls. Anpanman will go anywhere to help anyone in trouble, to drive away villains, and to save people from starvation by allowing them to eat his face. What? Let his face be eaten? No need to worry. His face is made with sweet anpan (bread filled with bean jam), hence the name Anpanman. Anpanman's very life depends on allowing others to eat, and once eaten, Anpanman can restore himself endlessly. He does not look handsome or strong, but he never fears any adventure and is continuously flying to aid the hungry people and the children with difficulties. Anpanman is the hero of the new age, glowing with friendship, endeavour and justice.

programme.title: Anego
programme.desc: 2005 — Naoko Noda, who works in a trading company, is called "anego" by her younger co-workers. What is "anego"? It means "older sister," but in this case it is given as a nickname to Naoko because she is like a big sister to her coworkers, who depend on her to give them advice about everything. This drama, depicts realistically how Naoko lives her everyday life, including her love life, the problems she faces, and her uneasiness about the future. --NTV

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.title: 252: Signal of Life
programme.desc: 2008 — 252 Seizonsha Ari — At some point in the distant future, a massive, catastrophic earthquake strikes Tokyo, causing the temperature of the Pacific Ocean to rise meteorically and the largest typhoon in recorded Japanese history to sweep toward the city and inundate it with water. The Tokyo Fire Department and its team of crack rescuers swing into action, and shortly after they do, a distress call arises from an underground subway station - with repeated indications of the rescue code, 252 252, and the exclamation "We Have Survivors." It soon becomes apparent that the local rescue squad must attempt to save the survivors, doing so at the expense of their own lives and safety. Written by Nathan Southern

Originally a 16-part "workplace comedy" online sketch series hosted on Rakuten TV, "Hiragana Ichimon" was released as a full movie cut on other platforms such as U-Next, while Netflix Japan retained the 16-part cut.

programme.title: Japan Unified Side Story: Yamazaki Gang 7 ~Little Love in Yamazaki~
programme.desc: 2023 — Nihon Tōitsu Gaiden Yamazaki Ichimon 7 ~Chīsana Koi no Yamazaki~ — Yamamura (Kenta Kawasaki), an anime otaku since his school days, hid his passion while living as a delinquent. Back then, he fell in love at first sight with transfer student Akiko (Kazusa Okuyama), only to be heartbroken. Years later, on the way to a regular family meeting, Yamamura, Joji (Takashi Kitadai), and Ishizawa (Hiroto Honda) stop by a café—where Joji and Ishizawa both instantly fall for the waitress, Akiko. Seeing the trio completely smitten, self-proclaimed love expert Nakashima (Yoshimi Tachi) offers to investigate her tastes, but secretly begins dating her himself. Determined to confess, Yamamura visits Akiko’s home, only to be met by her troubled expression. Behind it all is Horiuchi, a café regular who had always lingered on the edge of her world. Learning the truth, Yamamura races to save Akiko from her situation.

programme.title: Japan Unified Side Story: Yamazaki Ikkamon 8 ~ Metropolitan Police vs. Yamazaki Ikkamon ~
programme.desc: 2023 — Nihon Tōitsu Gaiden Yamazaki Ikkamon 8 ~ Keishichō VS Yamazaki Ikkamon ~ — A burglary hits the Yuseikai Kazo branch. The cash had already been moved from the safe, but Teru (Yutaka Kyan) is left pale and shaken. He drives Sakuragi (Takuma Sugawara) and the others out and locks himself inside the office, worrying Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi). Teru, however, is desperate to recover something he cannot afford to lose. As Nakashima (Yoshimi Tachi) predicted, the thief returns. Teru lies in wait and tries to capture him, but the burglars—two agile brothers known locally as the parkour brothers—escape with ease. The elder brother Ichiro (Joey) fell in with a theft ring for a specific reason. Meanwhile, it emerges that the string of burglaries may be connected to Fujimura, a Marubo detective…

programme.title: Japan Unified Side Story: Yamazaki Ikkamon 9 ~ A Mysterious Yamazaki Ikkamon ~
programme.desc: 2023 — Nihon Tōitsu Gaiden Yamazaki Ikkamon 9 ~ Yo nimo Kimyō na Yamazaki Ikkamon ~ — To avoid further attacks on Kawatani (Hitoshi Ozawa) by the Hagane-kai, Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya) and Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi) prepare several safe houses. As a precaution, Yuki (Yuki Oki) is sent to inspect one—but after seeing something, he returns screaming in terror. When the Yamazaki group later gathers, a visibly shaken Yuki insists, “That house is haunted.” His claims are brushed off as pests—except for Saito (Katsuya), who clearly believes him. Soon, the group somehow finds itself sharing ghost stories, unknowingly marking the start of a truly frightening inspection…

programme.title: Theatrical Version: Yamazaki Ikkamon ~ Japan Unified ~
programme.desc: 2022 — Gekijōban Yamazaki Ikkamon ~ Nihon Tōitsu ~ — Himuro is arrested on suspicion of assault. To prove his innocence, members of the Yamazaki Ichimon scramble to locate Ito—the older man Himuro once helped (Hiroo Otaka), who could serve as a key witness. Meanwhile, Tamura visits a certain hospital, where he is suddenly attacked by a man. After a fierce struggle, Tamura is arrested by police who rush to the scene. With the Kyowakai cornered and both Himuro and Tamura in jeopardy, the Yamazaki Ichimon splits up to continue their desperate search. Their efforts eventually lead them to Naomi (Saki Kiyoi), the daughter of Ito. As the investigation progresses, it becomes clear that the incident is tied to a gold smuggling operation. Just as the truth begins to surface, Naomi is kidnapped by the smugglers. The shocking mastermind behind the smuggling ring turns out to be an international spy organization. Can the Yamazaki Ichimon rescue Naomi—and clear both Himuro and Tamura of all charges?!

programme.title: A Bad Summer
programme.desc: 2025 — Warui Natsu [Kitamura Takumi Kawai Yūmi Shutsuen] — Sasaki is a sincere civil servant, working at city hall. Due to his timid personality, he can't properly deal with nasty people, including a single mother on the verge of giving up her own child, another civil servant pressing him to have a physical relationship, and a person who receives welfare benefits unfairly. His passivity leads him to get caught up in a terrible crime.

programme.title: Onsen Shark
programme.desc: 2024 — Onsen Shāku — In a small hot spring town in Japan, a ferocious ancient shark reawakens and begins terrorizing the local hot spring facilities. As the threat escalates, the townspeople band together to protect their beloved town from the menacing predator, leading to a fierce and thrilling battle.

programme.desc: Won’t bemad. 3 Ibaraki-ken Hinuma Shībassu — "Won’tbemad." starring professional angler Onuman, aka Masaya Onuma, who makes his living fishing for sea bass. Focusing in principle on day game only, he takes on fields all across Japan...

programme.title: Naruhodo! Offshore Fishing Master 10: Naruhodo! Filefish Fishing in Sagami Bay
programme.desc: Naruhodo! Okizuri Masutā 10 Sagami-wan no Kawahagi-zuri de Naruhodo! — A specialized offshore fishing program in which two masters of offshore fishing reveal everything, from tricks to little-known tips, under the keyword "naruhodo"! Watch this and you may hear information you didn't know before.

programme.title: AzingLab. 2nd 72: Boat Ajing
programme.desc: AzingLab. 2nd 72 Bōto Ajingu — This time, Tommy visited the Tobishima area of Kure City, Hiroshima Prefecture. He takes on boat ajing for the first time in a while. The aji raised in the fierce currents of the Seto Inland Sea are bigger in size and thickness, richly fatty and delicious!

programme.title: GAN's GANGS 87 GACKT Arrives! Part 1
programme.desc: GAN's GANGS 87 GACKT Kōrin! Zenpen — Kishu's master angler Takatoshi Hiraiwa, the originator of the S-shaped big bait, pursues big bass with his own theory and style. This time, it's a special project commemorating the 20th anniversary of the birth of the Jointed Claw!

programme.title: G WORLD 49: Sakura Salmon in Akita Prefecture's Main River
programme.desc: G WORLD 49 Akita-ken Honryū Sakuramasu — Keiryu and main-river fishing expert Tetsuya Hasegawa has spent years pursuing one fish: a sakura masu over two shaku long. He finally makes that dream come true in the clear streams of Akita.

programme.title: Fish Fury 7: Kamigoto Amberjack
programme.desc: Fish Fury 7 Kamigoto Hiromasa — This time, the trip is based in Hirado, Nagasaki Prefecture, and takes them over to the reefs of the Kamigoto area. The target is hiramasa, a fish that holds special meaning for Segawa. This is the first time for this program to target hiramasa in Japan.

programme.title: Pleasure Fishing, Pleasure Reef Fishing 86: Rock Fishing at Uwajima, Ehime, and Takeshima
programme.desc: Rakuchō Rakui Sengen 86 Ehime-ken Uwajima Takeshima de no Isozuri — Rock fishing is often seen as somewhat hard to approach. This programme dispels that image and conveys the fun of rock fishing to many anglers. This time, we target black sea bream on Takegashima in Uwajima, Ehime Prefecture!

programme.title: World Fishing Trip 5: Rainbow Trout in New Zealand
programme.desc: Sekai Tsuri Tabi 5 Nyūjīrando Reinbō Torauto — Fishing traveler Kenichi Akatsuka brings you "World Fishing Journey," in which he seeks out various game fish living on the planet, under the themes of fishing, sightseeing, and gear. This time, it's Tekapo Canal in New Zealand.

programme.title: Sea Fishing Gallery: Autumn Family Fishing on Awaji Island
programme.desc: Umizuri Gyararī Aki no Awaji-shima Famirī Fisshingu — "Sea Fishing Gallery" introduces various forms of fishing at familiar fishing spots. This time, we head to Awaji Island, Hyogo Prefecture! Yuuko-nee-san visited the fishing and family experience inn "Awakan" to scout it out for a family trip.

programme.title: From Kansai: I Really Want to Fish! 34
programme.desc: Kansai-hatsu Mecha Mecha Tsuritai! 34 — "Kansai Hatsu Mechamecha Tsuritai!" introduces fishing in season in Kansai. This time, they take on tenya tachiuo, a popular boat-fishing target in Osaka Bay! Their goal is a dragon over 120 cm long...

programme.title: Offshore Revolution NEXT 172: Fishing with Live Bait
programme.desc: Ofushoa Rebyūshon NEXT 172 Nagashi — "Off Revo NEXT" aims to discover something new in shore fishing, and even to revolutionize it. Tetsuya Takahashi and Tatsuya Matsuda, both experts in various types of fishing, convey the appeal of the sea through their experience and unique ideas.

programme.title: Rock Nation 9: Kazuki Maruyama × Uwakai
programme.desc: RockNation 9 Enzan Kazuki × Uwakai — Promoting Japan's proud shore fishing to the world. RockNation captures the true value of shore fishing through the skills and journeys of anglers who take on the rocks, and the way of life they stake on it. This time, appearing are...

programme.title: TSURInaKIBUN 20 FightnaKIBUN
programme.desc: Tsubasa Toshimizu-chan, who has become hooked on fishing, enjoys fishing with easygoing friends, but with all her might. This time, she invites YUKI-chan to take revenge on a fish that gave her a strong pull!

programme.title: Fishing-Crazy on the Weekend! 34: Owase, Mie Prefecture, Part 2
programme.desc: Kyūjitsu wa Tsuri ni Muchū! 34 Mie-ken Owase Kōhen — A real-life fishing diary by popular Instagrammer Mari Fuchigami and her friend Nisshan, as the two women head out on the water. A carefree women’s trip based in Kansai, presented as a real documentary.

programme.title: Goukai 11200 kg and More! Repeated! Atlantic Bluefin Tuna
programme.desc: Gōkai 11200kg Chō! Rensa! Taiheiyō no Kuromaguro — Gokai depicts a head-on battle with giant fish. This time, the stage is Cape Cod Bay in Massachusetts, USA. Despite struggling with rough seas, Tsurumaki Kaiken continues to pursue the bluefin tuna.

programme.title: Requested: The Straight Path to Chinu 33 - Mie, Miura Kakaritsuri
programme.desc: Rikuesuto: Chinu Dō Itchokusen 33 Mie・Miura no Kakaritsuri — We bring you "kakari-tsuri" from Miura in Kii-Nagashima, Mie Prefecture. Yes, it's been about two years since the program record (60.3 cm) was set at this very spot. Taro Yamamoto is always dreaming of encountering a giant black porgy.

programme.title: [FV CLASSIC] Denshin Denshō 24: Rock Fishing in Hong Kong
programme.desc: [FV CLASSIC] Denshin Denshō 24 Hong Kong no Isozuri — [FISHING VISION CLASSIC] We bring you classic programs broadcast on Fishing Vision in the past, featuring memorable masters. Whether you knew them back then or not, let your thoughts drift...

programme.title: Fish Galore! Hokushin'etsu! 17: Swordtip Squid in Fukui Prefecture
programme.desc: Osakana Zakuzaku Hokushin'etsu! 17 Fukui-ken Sodeika — Outdoor-loving girl Saori Kawaguchi from Toyama Prefecture takes on all kinds of fishing across the Hokuetsu region in "A Fish-Filled Hokuetsu!" This time, she tries her hand at squid fishing off Tsuruga, Fukui Prefecture!

programme.title: Enchanting Fishing 6: The Two Styles Behind Smelt Fishing
programme.desc: Miwaku no Tsuri 6 Futatsu no Ryūgi ga Ori Nasu Wakasagi Tsuri — "Miwaku no Tsurii" introduces the cultural side and profound appeal of fishing. This time, it's wakasagi fishing, a winter tradition. Master anglers Minoru Kubota and Katsuya Chishima explore its charm at Hibara Lake in Fukushima Prefecture.

programme.title: Azinglab. 2nd 68: Boat Ajing
programme.desc: Azinglab. 2nd 68 Bōto Ajingu — This time, the second episode of the program takes on boat ajing. Tommy introduces easy night ajing in Maizuru, Kyoto Prefecture, a casual activity to enjoy even in winter.

programme.title: ITT37: Attacking the Autumn Rocks of Nishiizu Tago
programme.desc: ITT37 Nishiizu Tago no Aki Iso o Semeru — A must-see show for shore anglers who want to level up their skills. Watch the sharpened techniques of Kiyoshi Tanaka, the absolute king of shore-based float fishing, who is aiming for an unprecedented ninth straight victory at the Daiwa Gure Masters!

programme.title: AREAWARS -Advance- 2
programme.desc: The revolutionary of the area trout scene, Eiichi Kikuchi, hosts guests from various fields and conveys the appeal of area fishing in an endless battle! This time, the stage is Aruk's Pond Utsunomiya in Tochigi Prefecture.

programme.title: [Shore Salt Special Across the Archipelago] Rock'n Fish 84: Shakotan Rock Game
programme.desc: [Rettō Jūdan! Shōa Soruto Tokushū] Rock'n Fish 84 Shakotan Rokku Gēmu — Rock'nFish pursues the depth of rockfish game fishing across all of Japan as its field. This time, on Hokkaido's Shakotan Peninsula, it focuses on shore rock fishing for ayu?

programme.title: BIG BITE 169: Conquering Yamaguchi Prefecture's Kanno Dam in Autumn!
programme.desc: BIG BITE 169 Aki no Yamaguchi-ken Kanno Dam Kōryaku! — The mission of this program is to vividly convey Toshifumi Kitamoto’s dynamic fishing style. This time, he takes on Suga-no Dam in Yamaguchi in autumn! The field he visits for the first time in 10 years is at full capacity after weekend rain.

programme.title: Rocky Shores 89: Trip to Nango and Mizushima, Miyazaki Prefecture
programme.desc: Iso o Kakeru 89 Miyazaki-ken Nangō・Mizushima no Tabi — Takuya Heiwa's journey in search of uncharted rocky shores. The stage for Chapter 89 is Nangō, Mizushima, in Miyazaki Prefecture. He returns to this place, which he says captivated him completely when he visited four years ago, and takes on a challenge for large onaga!

programme.title: Palm Tree Fishing Team, Saltwater Division 2: Yamaguchi Prefecture SLJ
programme.desc: Yashi no Ki Tsurisa Taī Kaisui-bu 2 Yamaguchi-ken SLJ — The "Yashi no Ki Fishing Expedition Team" was formed to answer anglers' wishes: where can you catch fish, and how do you catch them? This time, they investigate the waters off Yamaguchi Prefecture with super light jigging!

programme.title: Azing Lab. 2nd 76: Boat Ajing in Yamaguchi
programme.desc: Azingu Rabu. 2nd 76 Yamaguchi-ken Bōto Ajingu — This time, we introduce boat ajing in the Yanai area of Yamaguchi Prefecture! One of the charms of boat ajing is that it lets you access spots that are difficult to reach from shore and target large fish roaming the deeper waters.

programme.title: Fishing Is Romance! Chushikoku 9
programme.desc: Tsuri wa Romansu! Chūshikoku 9 — This time, the setting is Mimasaka City in Okayama Prefecture. As the season turns increasingly cold, what heats up instead is rainbow trout fishing at managed fishing ponds! Marli Fuchigami goes to investigate the trout scene in the Chugoku region!

He shares the joys and depth of fukase fishing, which captivates him, along with the Inokuma-style method! This time, the setting is Suo-Oshima, Yamaguchi Prefecture, in mid-October 2026.

programme.title: Fish Battle! 295: Hell Tour in Beppu Bay, Ōita?
programme.desc: Gyoru Shikaku Kakutōgi-sen! 295 Ōita Beppuwan de Jigoku Meguri!? — A fishing entertainment programme that takes on all kinds of fish around the world. This time, in Beppu Bay, Oita Prefecture, they展开 a casting game targeting seabass and blue-backed fish. What kind of encounters await!?

programme.title: Chinu Road Straight Ahead 127: Matoya Bay, Adako! Autumn Float Fishing
programme.desc: Chinu Dō Itchokusen 127 Matoya-wan Adako! Aki no Kakari-tsuri — The 127th installment of Chinu Michi Itchokusen takes place in Matoya Bay, Ada-ko, making its first appearance on the programme. During the catch-heavy season dominated by small and medium fish, we go after good-sized autumn chinu.

programme.title: Let's Try Salt Game 7: Let's Try Jigging Multi-Catch off Toba!
programme.desc: Let's try Sōto Gēmu 7 Toba-oki no Jigingomoku ni Let's try! — Ota-kun and Azecchi clearly introduce an easy-to-start saltwater lure game that anyone can enjoy anywhere in Japan! This time, the setting is off Toba, Mie Prefecture.

Eleven fishing-savvy women from Kanto, Kansai and Kyushu who are active on Fishing Vision gather for a serious battle!

programme.title: [FV Classic] The Dramatic Rocky Shore: Catch the Right Size Mebina!
programme.desc: [FV CLASSIC] Za Gekisō Mejina no Saizu o Tsuriwakero! — [FISHING VISION CLASSIC] Bringing you classic programmes that aired on Fishing Vision in the past, featuring memorable masters. Whether you knew them back then or not, please watch with fond memories in mind.

programme.title: Metal Buster 39: Amberjack off the Coast of Iki Island
programme.desc: Metaru Basutā 39 Iki-shima Shūhen Kaiki no Hiramasa — "Metal Buster" takes on various targets that migrate along the coast from shore. This time, set in the waters around Iki Island, Nagasaki Prefecture, the goal is autumn's large-size hiramasa yellowtail kingfish.

programme.title: Toton Egi Paradise 177: A Trip to Obama, Fukui
programme.desc: Tokoton Egiparadaisu 177 Fukui-ken Obama no Tabi — This episode of Egi Para welcomes third-generation assistant Katayama Manami as a teacher! Returning with the NEW Egi she produced herself, she takes on the shores of Obama, Fukui, together with the fourth-generation assistant.

programme.title: Let's Go, Area-kun 21: Magnum Takada Returns
programme.desc: Susume! Eria-kun 21 Kaettekita Magunamu Takada — The hugely popular area fishing variety show Suusume Area-kun is back! Magnum Takada, who has been striving toward the top of the area tournament, sets out toward a new goal!

programme.title: Herabuna Gallery: Compilation of Fishing in the Severe Cold
programme.desc: Herabuna Gyararī Gekkanki no Tsuri: Sōshūhen — Hera-buna, showing many different faces throughout the seasons. This fishing style, said to be one of Japan's traditional forms of game fishing, can be enjoyed in waters all across Japan, from managed fisheries to wild fishing spots.

programme.title: JB TOP 50 2026 Digest (New)
programme.desc: JB TOP 50 2026 Dajesuto — Japan's top-level bass tournament, "JB TOP 50." Around 50 top tournament anglers compete in five events a year for the title of Angler of the Year in this series competition.

programme.title: Follow my F 36 Aichi Prefecture, Aburagafuchi
programme.desc: follow my F 36 Aichi-ken Aburagafuchi — Legendary shore-bass angler Kotaro Kawamura travels across the country, fishing major waters nationwide, aiming to go "beyond his hometown." Today's stage is the tidal field of Yagabuchi in Aichi Prefecture.

programme.title: [Nationwide Shore Salt Special] SOUL JERKER 8 Miyazaki, Nichinan x Late-Autumn Egging
programme.desc: [Rettō Zōdan! Shōa Souruto Tokushū] SOUL JERKER 8 Miyazaki-ken Nichinan x Banshū Eggingu — The theme is plus-one eging. What kind of logic exists for catching the aori squid that has never been caught before? The theory-driven eginger Eisuke Kawakami gives a thorough explanation, with how-to tips as well!

programme.title: AREA WARS 14: A Deep Dive into Pool Trout
programme.desc: AREA WARS 14 Pūrutorauto Daikōsatsu — The revolutionary of area trout, Eiichi Kikuchi, collaborates with famous anglers from other genres. This time, area-fishing expert Hiroyuki Isono appears! They take on pool trout for the first time on the programme!

programme.title: Are you mad? 3: Landing in Shikoku! Pride of the Giant Bait
programme.desc: Are you mad? 3 Shikoku Jōriku! Jaianto Beito no Iji — Satan Shimada has long been frequenting Ikehara Dam and has landed many monster bass. This time he heads to Kochi in Shikoku. But on the day of filming, an abrupt cold snap hits... .

programme.title: Area Travelers 142: Kawaba & Nasu Kogen
programme.desc: Eriato Toraberāzu 142 Kawaba & Nasu Kōgen — Murata Motoi takes us on a journey through area-managed fishing spots. This time, he visits Kawaba Kingdom Fishing in Gunma and Nasu Kogen Lure Field in Tochigi. He takes on some of the most popular spots representing northern Kanto.
