programme.desc: Dawin ga Kita! Tokusen Eizō-shū — "Darwin ga Kita!" presents the wonders of the living world and nature all over the globe. From a huge archive, we carefully select the very best scenes. A precious collection of natural images on the theme of "color."

programme.title: The Joy of Nature 5 min. (23): Moto-Arakawa and the Sayama Hills in Saitama
programme.desc: Sawayaka Shizen Hyakkei 5min.(23) Saitama Moto-Arakawa to Sayama Kyūryō — This time, the setting is the Moto-Arakawa River flowing through central Saitama Prefecture and the Sayama Hills spanning Saitama and Tokyo. Both are bird paradises left close to where people live. In spring, we observe the energetic life of the birds.

programme.title: Reviving Shin Nihon Kiko Selection
programme.sub-title: Kyoto's mountain villages - the women of Ohara and Kitayama -
programme.desc: Yomigaeru Shin Nihon Kikō Sen — Shin Nihon Kikou comes vividly to life with the latest digital technology. This time, it is "Kyoto's Mountain Villages," broadcast in 1969. It features Ohara, buzzing with a tourism boom, and the women living strong lives in the Kitayama cedar-producing area.

programme.title: Ultraman On-Air 1-Minute Promo
programme.desc: Urutoraman Hōsō-chū 1-pun PR — Hayata of the Science Patrol collides with a mysterious red sphere during a patrol flight. Its true identity is Ultraman from the M78 Nebula. Becoming one, they face monsters and aliens.

programme.title: Seiya Nakai's Railway Journey!
programme.sub-title: Searching for the deepening autumn in Shizuoka
programme.desc: Nakai Seiya no Tetsutabi! — Railway photographer Seiya Nakai travels around Japan to rediscover the charms of each region. This time, he visits Shizuoka Prefecture, deep in autumn. He photographs stunning scenery such as Mount Fuji, the Oi River, and Lake Hamana together with the trains.

programme.title: Morning Drama: Honmamon (24)
programme.desc: Renzoku Terebi Shōsetsu Honnamon (24) — Yamanaka Konoha, the heroine, was born and raised in the mountain villages of Kumano, Wakayama Prefecture. Armed with her naturally gifted sense of taste, inherited from her father, she enters the world of cooking, where harsh training awaits. A morning drama series broadcast in 2001.

programme.title: The Art of Beauty
programme.sub-title: Koizumi Yakumo, who wove Japan’s heart into words
programme.desc: 2006 — Bi no Tsubo — The author who drew attention in a morning drama, Yakumo Koizumi. From the Japanese landscapes that captivated Yakumo, to the sound of insects he loved, and even the chirimen-bon that fused Japanese craftsmanship, we take a close look at Yakumo’s world of beauty!

programme.title: Nippon Colorful
programme.desc: Nippon Karafuru — Why not travel through nostalgic Japan along with nostalgic music? Here comes a 15-minute break for the heart. This time, we visit a "port town" of encounters and farewells, in a nationwide journey related to "Shin Nippon Fudoki".

programme.title: [Asadora] Blossom (36) Week 8
programme.desc: [Renzoku Terebi Shōsetsu] Burassamu (36) Dai 8-shū — Having returned to her hometown of Iwakuni, Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi) reunites with her mother Ryo (Ryoko Kuninaka), her younger brother Mamoru (Wataru Hyuga), Hideo (Taishi Ishizaka), and her younger sister Toshiko (Sora Ito).

programme.title: Blossom (37) Week 8
programme.desc: [Renzoku Terebi Shōsetsu] Burassamu (37) Dai 8-shū — Tama (Shizuka Ishibashi), who spends her days in Iwakuni, visits the storehouse filled with memories from her childhood. There, she recalls memories of her father Seiji (Takuro Watabe).

programme.title: Serial TV Novel: Blossom (38) Week 8
programme.desc: Renzoku Terebi Shōsetsu Burassamu (38) Dai 8-shū — Shu (Shizuka Ishibashi) returns to Tokyo and focuses on writing. Through letters, she tells Kou (Daichi Kaneko), who is in Sapporo, that she wants to stay in Tokyo to work on her next book...

programme.title: Blossom (39) Week 8
programme.desc: Burassamu (39) Dai 8-shū — Jin (Shizuka Ishibashi) continues her days working on her manuscript, and at Shuto Koron, which she visits, she meets young writer Ichiro Nishio (Shota Sometani). As completion of her next work draws near, an unexpected visitor comes to see Jin...

programme.title: Asadora: Blossom (40), Week 8
programme.desc: [Renzoku Terebi Shōsetsu] Burassamu (40) Dai 8-shū — Tama keeps writing, and finishes her new work, "The Noise of the Town," before the deadline; it is published in Chuto Koron. After finishing her writing, the young writer Ichiro Nishio (Shota Someya) appears again before Tama...

programme.title: Wildlife Planet Earth III: Desert Grasslands, Living with Humans
programme.desc: Wairudo Raifu Puranetto Āsu III Sabaiku Sōgen Hito to Ikiru — The series Planet Earth III tells the story of life on Earth through stunning imagery. It introduces animals living in harsh deserts, lush grasslands, and the human world.

programme.title: Totto-chan's Treasure 2
programme.desc: Totto-chan no Takaramono 2 — Kuroyanagi Tetsuko is someone who never throws things away. Her home is full of gifts from people she was close to. Enjoy plenty of moving stories about Tetsuko and the stars behind each treasured keepsake!

programme.title: Playback Super Video! The Secret of Seiji Ozawa's Genius
programme.desc: Pureibakku Chō Eizō! Ozawa Seiji Shinkyō no Himitsu — Seiji Ozawa, hailed as "Ozawa of the World," received rave reviews. What is so amazing about his conducting? From ultra-high-definition concert footage where even his hand movements and gaze are visible, we explore the secret behind his seemingly miraculous conducting.

programme.title: Grand Sumo Tournament (2026) - Kyushu Tournament, Day 14
programme.desc: Ōzumō (2026-nen) Kyūshū Basho Jūyokka-me — *Secondary audio is arena sound — live from Fukuoka International Center — [Broadcast continues on 102ch]

programme.title: Speed Skating World Cup Obihiro, Day 2
programme.desc: Supīdo Sukēto Wārudokappu Obihiro Taikai Dai 2-nichi — In the men's 500m, Japan's sprint ace Moriage Wataru is scheduled to compete. He will battle for the podium against the world's top skaters, including the "fastest man in the world" Jordan Stolz (USA)!

programme.title: Piano Around the Corner, 25 min.
programme.desc: Machikado Piano 25 min. — Montreal, Canada's second-largest city. A piano placed in a public market long beloved as the city's "kitchen." What thoughts drive the people who visit there to play a tune? We watched with a fixed camera.

programme.title: Japan’s 100 Famous Mountains Mini 3 min
programme.desc: Nippon Hyakumeizan Mini 3min — A mountain trip aiming for Asahidake (1870 m)! A walk along the brilliant, colorful ridges representing Tohoku is full of moving moments! The guide praises the autumn leaves as "the best day, beyond words"! The drone footage is superb!

programme.title: Ahead of the broadcast of "The Inugami Family" and "The Devil's Temari Song (Parts 1 & 2)", we present Part 2 of "The Inugami Family"!
programme.desc: "Akuma no Temari Uta Zenkōhen" hōsō ni mukete "Inugami-ke no Ichizoku Kōhen" o hōsō! — The broadcast of "Akuma no Temari Uta: Parts 1 and 2" is approaching! programme.title: A 1-Minute Promo for "What Is My Worth in This Crisis?
programme.desc: 2021 — "Ima Koko ni Aru Kiki to Boku no Kōkando ni Tsuite" 1-pun PR — Matsuzaka Tori, starring in the 2027 taiga drama "Gyakuzoku no Bakushin," plays a young man working in a university public relations office. Jostled by the various problems the university faces, he finds his own way of life in this black comedy.

programme.title: Drama: This Taste Will Also Be Missed Someday, Part 2

programme.desc: Otakara o Horiatatero!! Taiwan Anteeiku Kangei Tabi: Miwaku no Hisui to Chaki-hen — Actress Michiko Hada and gardener-actor Tatsukiyo Murasame go treasure-hunting at a flea market in Taiwan! programme.desc: Yomigaeru Shuri-jō ~Ryūkyū Ōkoku no Iro ni Idomu~ — The exterior of Shuri Castle's main hall is finally complete. programme.desc: [4K] « Shopin Konkūru Ten'nōtachi no Kyōen » Puri — On BSP4K, starting in April, every Thursday at 6:00 p.m., we will broadcast "Chopin Competition: The Genius Showdown." Please enjoy the superb performances, including those by all of the Japanese participants.

programme.title: [4K] 4K Premium Café: Iguazu National Park, Home of the World’s Largest Waterfall
programme.desc: [4K] 4K Puremiamu Kafe Sekai Saidai no Taki Iguasu Kokuritsu Kōen — Hi-Vision Special: Visiting the World's Natural Heritage The World's Largest Waterfall - Iguazu National Park ▽Breathtaking images and sound depict the wonders of nature. (First broadcast: 2003).

programme.title: Japan's 100-Year Heritage: Stories of Long-Established Shops to Pass on to the Future - Gentle Sweetness, the Taste of Family, Tokyo Kanda
programme.desc: [4K] Nihon Hyaku-nen Isan Mirai e Okuru Shinise Monogatari Yasashii Amasa wa Kazoku no Aji Tōkyō Kanda — The story of a venerable shop with over 100 years of history. This time, the setting is a sweets and liquor store that has been run by generations of the same family at the foot of Kanda Myojin. It preserves the "koji" cultivated in the workshop used since the early Edo period.

programme.title: [4K] Journey Across Japan: Kokoro Tabi Encore, 323rd Week, Ōita Prefecture
programme.desc: [4K] Nippon Jūdan Kokoro Tabi O-kawari 323 Shūme Ōita-ken — This week on "Kokorotabi," the morning repeat is an encore presentation of "Okawari"! This time, it’s Oita Prefecture in March 2025. Great scenes and unaired footage, plus the "heart landscapes" that Misako-san couldn’t visit!

programme.title: [4K] Ultraman Returns PR [HDR]
programme.desc: [4K] Kaettekita Urutoraman PR [HDR] — To mark the 60th anniversary of the Ultraman series, "Return of Ultraman 4K Remastered Version" is airing every Friday at 6:00 p.m. on NHK BS Premium 4K! Don't miss this opportunity!

programme.title: Seiya Nakai's Scenic Train Travel: Late Autumn in Hyogo - Journey Along Rails Dyed in Brocade
programme.desc: Nakai Seiya no Zekkei! Tetsutabi Banshū no Hyōgo Nishi ni Somaru Tetsuro o Yuku! — Railway photographer Seiya Nakai rediscovers the wonders of local railways. This time, he travels along three lines in southern Hyogo in late autumn. Getting off along the way to meet people, he captures breathtaking scenery with his camera.

programme.title: [4K] "Chopin Competition: A Clash of Geniuses" Preview
programme.desc: [4K] « Shopin Konkūru Ten'nōtachi no Kyōen » Puri — On BSP4K, starting in April, every Thursday at 6:00 p.m., we will broadcast "Chopin Competition: The Genius Showdown." Please enjoy the superb performances, including those by all of the Japanese participants.

programme.title: Streets of the World
programme.desc: [4K] Sekai Fureai Machiaruki — Sofia, the capital of Bulgaria. Walk through this "crossroads of civilizations" where Eastern and Western cultures mingle, with Roman baths loved by an emperor, mosques from the Ottoman era, traditional instruments, and more. [Narration] Tomoko Nakajima, Yoichi Nukumizu.

programme.title: 1 Minute of Broadchurch
programme.desc: ★ 7.9/10 · 2013 — 1-pun de Burōdochāchi: Satsui no Machi — In one minute, "Broadchurch: The Town of Murder" on BSP4K. Broadcast every Tuesday at 5:00 p.m.

programme.title: Darwin's Amazing Animals! "Epic Battle! Desert Giraffes vs. Desert Lions
programme.desc: Darwin ga Kita! "Shukumei no Tatakai! Sabaku Kiriin Tai Sabaku Raion" — There are giraffes in the Namib Desert! They are called "desert giraffes." How can they live in the blazing desert? They reveal one amazing power after another! We follow their life-or-death struggle against their arch-enemy, the desert lion!

programme.title: European Hidden Hot Springs Journey: France — Prats-Balaguer Hot Spring
programme.desc: Yōroppa Hikiyu Jānyī Furansu Purattsu-Baragē Onsen — A hidden hot spring in Europe: Prat-Balaguer Onsen in the Pyrenees of southern France. Spend a healing moment at this famous spring set in the forest.

programme.title: [4K] The Forbidden City: The Emperor's Secret Garden
programme.desc: Shikyūjō Kōtei no Shirarezaru Hanazono — The Forbidden City, the palace of the Chinese emperor. Deep inside, the emperor created a secret garden (Qianlong Garden). Together with writer Jiro Asada, we explore the unseen buildings, the history that dwells there, and its world view. Featuring Shinnosuke Mitsushima.

programme.title: 1 Minute of Broadchurch
programme.desc: ★ 7.9/10 · 2013 — 1-pun de Burōdochāchi: Satsui no Machi — In one minute, "Broadchurch: The Town of Murder" on BSP4K. Broadcast every Tuesday at 5:00 p.m.

programme.title: [4K] Reviving New Japan Journey Selection: Drums of the Basin - Chichibu
programme.desc: Yomigaeru Shin Nihon Kikō Sen Bonchi no Taiko - Chichibu - — The 1969 episode of Shin Nihon Kiko is brought vividly to life with the latest digital technology. Set in harsh natural surroundings, it looks at the thoughts of the people who once a year pour their hearts into the splendid, grand "Chichibu Night Festival".

programme.title: [4K] The Inugami Family Murders PR
programme.desc: [4K] Akuma no Temari Uta PR — Based on Seishi Yokomizo’s novel. The fifth installment of NHK’s Kindaichi Kosuke series, "The Devil’s Temari Song," is coming to NHK BS! A one-minute distillation of the appeal of this gem of a mystery, told in two parts.

programme.title: [4K] Now On Air! BS Period Drama
programme.desc: Tadaima Hōsō-chū! BS Jidaigeki — Oichi, the heroine living in an Edo Fukagawa tenement, dreams of becoming a doctor and helps out her father, Dr. Shoan. A period mystery drama and a coming-of-age story about Oichi, who aspires to become a doctor for women.

programme.title: [4K] Street Piano Vol. 2
programme.desc: Machikado Piano vol. 2 — Hyogo Prefecture's Kobe City is said to be the city with the most street pianos in Japan. In a beloved underground shopping arcade, there is a popular grand piano. In this music-filled city, what melodies will people play?

programme.title: [4K] Nippon Camera Eye: The Mad Pitching Machine
programme.desc: Nippon Kamera Ai Kyōki no Pitching Machine — The world's fastest pitching machine, throwing at 250 km/h. People fascinated by the madness embodied in this machine that fires blazing fastballs continue to face the instant the ball is released and push their own limits.

programme.title: Great Traverse: Mountain Ancient Path, Road of Salt (4) - Grand Traverse of the Ina Mountains!
programme.desc: [4K] Gurēto Torabāsu Sanmyaku Kodo: Shio no Michi (4) Ina Sanchi Daizenshū! — Pro adventure racer Yoiki Tanaka travels from the Sea of Japan to the Pacific, following the 420-km salt road only on foot. This time, he takes on the hardest section of the journey: the 50-km traverse of the Ina Mountains!

programme.title: DOC 2: Medical Charts for Tomorrow
programme.desc: DOC (Dokku) 2 Asu e no Karute — The story of Andrea, a doctor who has lost twelve years of memories, about love and rebirth. A one-minute introduction to the highlights of Season 2, broadcast in 4K. Andrea returns to internal medicine. An unknown virus strikes Italy.

programme.title: Broadchurch (6)
programme.desc: Burōdochāchi Satsui no Machi (6) — A mystery and human drama set in a small town, where an incident shakes up the residents' daily lives. Hardy grows more suspicious of Pastor Paul, while newspaper reporter Maggie investigates Susan on her own.

programme.title: Musée d'Orsay Mini
programme.desc: Orusē Bijutsukan Mini — Masterpieces from the Musée d'Orsay in 3 minutes. A work that lets you savor the "sun-like feel" of Monet and Manet. A work that makes you feel the "moon-like texture" of Rousseau, Vuillard and Moreau. The door to beauty opens here!

programme.title: Let's Go to the Far Ends! Remote Railways 10-Minute Mini: Madagascar, FCE Railway (1)
programme.desc: Iku zo! Saihate! Hikyō × Tetsudō 10-pun Mini Madagaskaru・FCE Tetsudō (1) — Loaded up, loaded up! The banana train races through a village without electricity. A single locomotive on wobbly tracks, plus a mysterious rental train! Even an ultra-rickety line is fine - what is the villagers' ultimate love for railways?

programme.title: Bullet Airport Round-Trip Tour: Cambodia, Techo Airport
programme.desc: Dangan! Kūkō Tomba-gaeri Tūā Kambodia Techo Kūkō — A whirlwind report on the world's most interesting airports! This time, we head to Cambodia's huge Techo Airport. Starting from an airport greeted by a giant Buddha statue, enjoy ruins and street food on a "day-trip airport tour".

programme.title: [4K] About the Crisis Right Here and My Image
programme.desc: 2021 — [4K] Ima koko ni aru Kiki to Boku no Kōkando ni Tsuite 1-pun PR — Set at a prestigious national university, this black comedy follows a young man who unexpectedly ends up working in the public relations department as he is swept along by the handling of various problems facing the university, while finding his own way of life.

programme.title: 8K Time-Lapse Journey: Fukui
programme.desc: 8K Taimurappusu Kikō ~Fukui~ — A 8K time-lapse journey shot with an 8K digital single-lens reflex camera. Enjoy the late-autumn scenery of the Echizen Coast in Fukui Prefecture, as well as footage of the Echizen crab landing season. (Broadcast in 2018).

programme.title: Great Nature 10 min. Andes: Mystical Land of Vivid Colors - Peru, South America
programme.desc: Gurēto Nichā 10-min. Andesu Shinpi no Gokusaichi ~Nampu・Peru~ — A vivid turquoise river, Rainbow Mountain where strata in brilliant red, blue and orange are exposed... We get to the bottom of the mystery behind the colorful scenery spread across a part of the Andes in Peru, South America.

programme.title: Cross-Country Heart Journey: Archive Special
programme.desc: [4K] Nippon Zengdū Kokoro Tabi Kura-dashi Supesharu — This week's "Cocoro Tabi" features a "Treasures from the Vault Special" in the daytime (BS only) and at night! On this day, it's a trip around Oita Prefecture in March 2025, when Misako Tanaka traveled there! Packed with memorable scenes and never-before-seen behind-the-scenes footage!

programme.title: [4K] Wildlife: A Great Journey from Antarctica to the Equator — Penguin Current [HDR]
programme.desc: [4K] Wairudorifū Nankyoku kara Akashi made Pengin Kairyū Ōinaru Tabi [HDR] — Around the Humboldt Current in South America lies a surprisingly diverse world of penguins. From frozen lands and storm-lashed islands to desert islands, we travel from Antarctica to the Equator along the far-reaching “Penguin Current.”

programme.title: [4K] Ultraman Returns PR [HDR]
programme.desc: [4K] Kaettekita Urutoraman PR [HDR] — To mark the 60th anniversary of the Ultraman series, "Return of Ultraman 4K Remastered Version" is airing every Friday at 6:00 p.m. on NHK BS Premium 4K! Don't miss this opportunity!

programme.title: [4K] Agatha Christie's Poirot (30)
programme.sub-title: The Mysterious Affair at Hunter's Lodge
programme.desc: [4K] Meitantei Poirot (30) — Agatha Christie's popular series Poirot is broadcast in 4K! Poirot and Hastings go out hunting. Waiting for them there is a murder case meticulously planned in advance.

programme.title: [4K] Frontier Select: What Is Eastern Medicine? [HDR]
programme.desc: [4K] Furontia Sentaku Tōyō Ichi to wa Nani ka [HDR] — What effects does acupuncture and moxibustion have? How do herbal medicines work? "Oriental medicine" has long been shrouded in mystery. Now, cutting-edge science is revealing its new possibilities.

programme.title: Wildlife PR [HDR]
programme.desc: [4K] Wairudo Raifu PR [HDR] — A 1-minute promo to further publicize Wildlife to a wider audience.

programme.title: [4K] 4K Premium Café: Iguazu National Park, Home of the World’s Largest Waterfall
programme.desc: [4K] 4K Puremiamu Kafe Sekai Saidai no Taki Iguasu Kokuritsu Kōen — Hi-Vision Special: Visiting the World's Natural Heritage The World's Largest Waterfall - Iguazu National Park ▽Breathtaking images and sound depict the wonders of nature. (First broadcast: 2003).

programme.title: Pumpkin Scissors
programme.desc: 2006 — Pampukin Shizāzu — Pumpkin Scissors is a manga created and authored by Ryotaro Iwanaga. Originally serialized in Magazine GREAT in 2002 it was later moved to Monthly Shonen Magazine in October 2006. The manga has been licensed by Del Rey. An anime adaptation of Pumpkin Scissors has been released, produced by Gonzo and AIC, which began airing on October 2, 2006 across several Japanese television stations and ended with the 24th episode on March 19, 2007. The series was originally licensed to the North American market by ADV Films for $780,000. In 2008 it became one of over thirty titles transferred from ADV Films to FUNimation, the main distributor of anime in the English speaking world.

programme.title: Pumpkin Scissors
programme.desc: 2006 — Pampukin Shizāzu — Pumpkin Scissors is a manga created and authored by Ryotaro Iwanaga. Originally serialized in Magazine GREAT in 2002 it was later moved to Monthly Shonen Magazine in October 2006. The manga has been licensed by Del Rey. An anime adaptation of Pumpkin Scissors has been released, produced by Gonzo and AIC, which began airing on October 2, 2006 across several Japanese television stations and ended with the 24th episode on March 19, 2007. The series was originally licensed to the North American market by ADV Films for $780,000. In 2008 it became one of over thirty titles transferred from ADV Films to FUNimation, the main distributor of anime in the English speaking world.

programme.title: The Story of Kyoto's Water
programme.desc: 2021 — Kyō no Mizu Monogatari — The capital of the Heian period, where it is said that Emperor Shirakawa once lamented, ‘The waters of the Kamo River, the dice of the board game sugoroku, and the mountain monks—these are the things that do not sit well with my heart’, is built upon a vast alluvial fan. It is said that the Kyoto Basin contains a volume of water equivalent to that of Lake Biwa. This abundance of water and the flow of its rivers have nurtured the culture of Kyoto. In this programme, we will introduce the culture of Kyoto through the lens of ‘water’.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.title: Kyoto Gaho
programme.desc: 2021 — Kyōto Gahō — Kyoto attracts tourists from all over the world. The reason is simple: it preserves authentic culture shaped by 1,200 years of tradition. This program presents the latest in Kyoto's beauty, wisdom, art, craftsmanship, and cuisine to people living a quality lifestyle. Hosted by actor Takako Tokiwa. Every month, we bring you high-definition footage on a variety of themes, such as Kyoto's hospitality culture in its inns and accommodations and Kyoto's washoku culture, featuring not only temples and shrines but also information on new shops, interviews with key figures in Kyoto, exhibition news from museums and art galleries, and souvenir ideas.

programme.title: The Story of Kyoto's Water
programme.sub-title: Keage Water Treatment Plant No. 1 High-Level Reservoir
programme.desc: 2021 — Kyō no Mizu Monogatari — The capital of the Heian period, where it is said that Emperor Shirakawa once lamented, ‘The waters of the Kamo River, the dice of the board game sugoroku, and the mountain monks—these are the things that do not sit well with my heart’, is built upon a vast alluvial fan. It is said that the Kyoto Basin contains a volume of water equivalent to that of Lake Biwa. This abundance of water and the flow of its rivers have nurtured the culture of Kyoto. In this programme, we will introduce the culture of Kyoto through the lens of ‘water’.

programme.title: An-chan
programme.desc: Set in a hot spring town, this warm-hearted downtown drama follows the ordinary young man Ittetsu Tanonaka, who used to work in Tokyo as a manager and trainer for a women's pro-wrestling team, as he is suddenly forced to serve as the head priest of a temple after his father's sudden death. He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)

programme.title: The Story of Kyoto's Water
programme.desc: 2021 — Kyō no Mizu Monogatari — The capital of the Heian period, where it is said that Emperor Shirakawa once lamented, ‘The waters of the Kamo River, the dice of the board game sugoroku, and the mountain monks—these are the things that do not sit well with my heart’, is built upon a vast alluvial fan. It is said that the Kyoto Basin contains a volume of water equivalent to that of Lake Biwa. This abundance of water and the flow of its rivers have nurtured the culture of Kyoto. In this programme, we will introduce the culture of Kyoto through the lens of ‘water’.

He had received basic training to become a priest, but for a young man who had lived freely in the city for nearly 10 years after graduating university, the work is a great burden. Thanks to his late father's personality, in a small town like this, the priest's role was not limited to ceremonies but also included everything from advice on worries to welfare work, serving as a catch-all for all kinds of troubles. Longing for his carefree city life, Ittetsu is torn. With the support and encouragement of his mother and sisters, and the help of old friends, this cheerful human drama depicts his growth into a fully fledged head priest. (26 episodes)
